vb_textbox.text: The gnomes come in pairs of either red and green or purple and brown. Only one of these is likely to point you to a lot of mushrooms at once and typically will stay the same for a few rounds before the other gnome starts to produce more instead (e.g the brown gnome may give +8 mushrooms for a few rounds before giving less, at which point the purple one will start giving more). When you notice a gnomes mushrooms start to decrease below +5, switch to the othert colour of gnome. This effect resets when the colours change (i.e switching from red/green to purple/brown). Good luck!
